evidence_quotes.agenda: 'What are your biggest concerns on this upcoming move?' — asked right after confirming his profile, before logistics probing began.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — customer said 'I don't have particular concern, I just wanted to move.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: A clean, concrete pay-less-if-faster example landed ('let's say everything will be done in just 3 hours including travel time then you will only be paying for 3') alongside the estimate-variability framing. No rate-commit line, no self-prep tip, no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Confidently and transparently answered a pointed comparison question ('other companies normally offer three movers, do you think two will do the job?') without being defensive or overselling — built real trust in that moment.
coaching_note: This is the strongest call in the batch and close to Green — the customer effectively self-closed by asking about appointment timing, and the rep never had to make an explicit close ask; worth still building the habit of asking directly ('would you like our help with your move?') even when momentum is clearly already there, so the muscle is there for calls that don't self-close. Total rounded from a raw component sum of 73.5 (half-point from a Stage 2 split).
